note: Provenance for everything in this repo that came from somewhere else. `upstream` names where it originates; `via` is the commit it was taken from. `upstream_name` is the directory it occupies upstream when that differs from ours — the drift job resolves by it. `diverged` means our copy differs from upstream on purpose and says why — the weekly drift job flags a marker that no longer matches reality. `note` is history that is not a divergence. `authored_here` marks files written for this marketplace rather than copied. Refresh against upstream by diffing these paths. See ADR 0011.
upstream_mirror_baseline: mattpocock/skills @ main (v1.2.0-dev), mirrored by justinpbarnett/ai@e36ec09. Most skills are still at that baseline; the `via` on each entry is authoritative where it differs. Upstream has since regrouped skills/<name> into skills/<category>/<name>, which is why resolution goes through directory name rather than path.

excluded_skills.ask-matt: Upstream skill about its own author. Not useful here. See ADR 0007.
excluded_skills.contribute: Upstream OSS contribution flow; forks into ~/dev/. No department does this. See ADR 0014.
excluded_skills.handoff: Upstream skill for handing a session to another agent. Dropped 2026-08-06 — nothing references it and no department asked for it. See ADR 0018.
excluded_skills.writing-great-skills: Upstream's guide to writing skills, since renamed writing-for-agents. Dropped 2026-08-06: it served contributors, and contributing is rare enough to read the file in the repo instead of carrying it in everyone's picker. See ADR 0018.
excluded_skills.setup-repo: Upstream's setup-matt-pocock-skills, renamed by ADR 0014. ADR 0015 removed its issue-tracker section once Jira became a given; what remained was a label mapping whose two columns were identical and a doc layout domain-modeling creates lazily anyway. Dropped 2026-08-06. See ADR 0019.

contaminated_skills.note: Claude Code's own built-ins, written into the source directory by the tool rather than chosen by anyone. Never shippable — see ADR 0007 and the CONTEXT.md definition. CI fails if any of these names appears under plugins/.

refinement_pass: 2026-08 rubric pass: every one of the 31 skills was reviewed against the writing-great-skills rubric (no-ops, duplication, leading words, completion criteria, negation, progressive disclosure). Skills vendored from an upstream therefore diverge from it in wording throughout, beyond what any per-skill `diverged` marker names. Those markers record structural and behavioural divergence — new files, changed contracts, retargeted pointers — not prose. See ADR 0020.
